title: Affine pushforward stalk as a localization of inverse-image sections
statement: Let f:X → Y be an affine morphism of schemes [pqf-def-affine-morphism, def-pc-scheme], U an affine open of Y, y ∈ U, B = Γ(Y,U), A = Γ(X,f⁻¹U), and q the prime of B corresponding to y [lem-weil-pbc-affine-open-stalk-localization]. The germ A → (f_*O_X)_y makes (f_*O_X)_y an A-algebra which is a localization of A at the submonoid image of B minus q under f.app U. This includes an empty inverse image.

source.place: Tag 0AVW, lemma-affine-morphism-equivalence, affine stalk calculation; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0AVW

proof.text: Write B = Γ(Y,U), A = Γ(X,f⁻¹U), q = hU.primeIdealOf y, and F = f_*O_X. The germ A → F_y defines its A-algebra structure. Use the affine stalk localization B → O_{Y,y} and IsLocalization.AtPrime.isUnit_to_map_iff to identify membership of y in D(b) with b ∈ B minus q. For every b outside q, its germ in O_{Y,y} is a unit. Mapping this germ through stalkFunctor.map f.c and applying stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply proves that the image of f.app U b in F_y is a unit.

For z ∈ F_y choose a section over a neighborhood V using exists_germ_eq. Shrink V to a basic open D(b) of the affine U containing y, using IsAffineOpen.exists_basicOpen_le. Its inverse image is D(f.app U b), by Scheme.Hom.preimage_basicOpen. Since f⁻¹U is affine, isLocalization_of_eq_basicOpen identifies its sections with A localized at powers of f.app U b. IsLocalization.surj supplies a numerator a and denominator (f.app U b)^n. Apply the germ ring homomorphism, use germ_res_apply and map_mul, and obtain z times the denominator germ equal to the numerator germ. The denominator lies in the image of B minus q.

If a,b ∈ A have equal germs in F_y, germ_eq supplies a neighborhood V where their restrictions agree. Shrink to D(c) containing y. Functoriality of restriction preserves the equality there. Its inverse image is D(f.app U c), whose sections are a localization of A at powers of f.app U c. IsLocalization.exists_of_eq gives an exponent n with (f.app U c)^n a = (f.app U c)^n b. This denominator also lies in the image of B minus q. Combining the units, fractions, and equality properties with isLocalization_iff proves the claim. All constructions also apply to the zero ring when the inverse image is empty.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_pushforward_stalk_isLocalization
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsAffineHom f]
    {U : Y.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (y : U) :
    let F := (TopCat.Presheaf.pushforward CommRingCat f.base).obj X.presheaf
    letI : Algebra (X.presheaf.obj (op (f ⁻¹ᵁ U))) (F.stalk y) :=
      (F.germ U y y.property).hom.toAlgebra
    IsLocalization
      ((hU.primeIdealOf y).asIdeal.primeCompl.map (f.app U).hom) (F.stalk y)
